title: Sanitize non-stale evaluator evidence recovery diagnostics
outcome: Keep the stable infrastructure classification and actionable host-generated timeout detail when evaluator evidence recovery fails. Normalize diagnostic text before it reaches the evaluator response, retained attempt history or parent outcome. Use a bounded allowlist or approved redaction for transport failures that can contain raw stderr or a local executable path.
acceptance: A deterministic recovery fixture verifies that diagnostic stdout or stderr and absolute executable paths from a transport failure are absent from the evaluator reply, retained failure and parent outcome.
A host-generated deadline still presents the stable deadline classification and actionable timeout detail, and a failed recovery remains separate from any criterion verdict.
